description: GCP predefined IAM roles required for CleanCloud AI/ML scanning (--category ai)
note: Assign these roles in addition to the hygiene roles in security/gcp/hygiene-readonly-roles.json. All roles are read-only.

roles.title: Vertex AI Viewer
roles.justification: List and read Vertex AI Online Prediction endpoints, Custom Jobs, and Training Pipelines to detect idle or runaway workloads

roles.title: Monitoring Viewer
roles.justification: Read Cloud Monitoring time-series metrics for idle detection signals across all AI/ML rules (endpoint prediction counts, TPU duty cycle, Feature Store serving requests)
roles.note: Already required for hygiene rules (Cloud SQL idle detection). No additional grant needed if hygiene roles are already bound.

roles.title: Notebooks Viewer
roles.justification: List and read Vertex AI Workbench instances (both v1 User-Managed Notebooks and v2 Workbench) to detect idle instances with ongoing compute charges

roles.title: Cloud TPU Viewer
roles.justification: List and read Cloud TPU nodes across all zones to detect idle READY-state nodes incurring continuous compute charges

binding_scope.recommended: Organization level — grants access to all current and future projects
binding_scope.alternative: Project level — grants access to a single project only

quick_setup.description: Add Vertex AI Viewer to your existing service account

enable_api.description: Vertex AI API must be enabled in each project you want to scan
enable_api.note: Projects with Vertex AI API disabled return 0 findings (rule is skipped, not an error)

enable_notebooks_api.description: Notebooks API must be enabled in each project you want to scan for Workbench instances
enable_notebooks_api.note: Projects with the Notebooks API disabled return 0 findings for the workbench rule (skipped, not an error)
